title: Analgesics in the Pre-hospital Setting: Implications on Hemorrhage Tolerance - Fentanyl
brief_summary: The purpose of this project is to test how fentanyl, an analgesic currently employed in the pre-hospital setting by the US Army, alters the capacity to tolerate a hemorrhagic insult in humans.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy
* Non-obese (body mass index less than 30 kg/m2)
* Body mass greater than or equal to 65 kg

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who have cardiac, respiratory, neurological and/or metabolic illnesses
* Any known history of renal or hepatic insufficiency/disease
* Pregnancy or breast feeding
* Current smokers, as well as individuals who regularly smoked within the past 3 years
* Positive urine drug screen
* Currently taking pain modifying medication(s)
